'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an ingredient used in cooking. In the base game, the only source is [[Rosa]], the [[Shepherd]]'s wife. For the main page on preparing food, see [[cooking]]. With [[Game of Crone]] you can also make it yourself after you unlock the recipe during the quest from the [[cook]] in the [[Refugee camp]]
